title: Show HN: Echo – Fable-level results at 1/3 the cost using open-weight models
summary: Echo is an experimental AI system that pools multiple open-weight models (like GLM-5.2, Kimi K2.7) and intelligently routes tasks to the most suitable models, achieving high-quality results at approximately one-third the cost of using premium closed models.
problem_solved: Reduces the cost-quality tradeoff in AI systems by intelligently combining multiple open-weight models instead of relying on expensive single premium models.
why_valuable: Enables access to competitive AI performance at significantly lower cost by leveraging model diversity and intelligent task routing across open-weight models.
